title: バッテリー式レシプロソー
description: 建物保守や改修作業台向けの携帯往復のこ。長いモーター胴、前方のゴム状握り、実際に開いたD型ハンドル、固定トリガーとバッテリー、クランプ、実スロット付き靴板、実形状の歯を持つ薄い直線刃を造形。丸刃の機械とは切断部と保持構造が異なり、刃と電池を含む一式1点です。往復・切断・靴板調整・電池動作は未実装で、刃性能や実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.094 × 0.205 × 0.669 m、7,052三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A portable reciprocating-saw prop for building-maintenance and refurbishment benches. It has a long motor housing, front rubber-like grip, genuinely open D handle, fixed trigger and battery, clamp, slotted shoe and thin straight blade with modeled teeth. Cutting and holding structures differ from a circular-blade tool; blade and battery are part of one assembly. Reciprocation, cutting, shoe adjustment and battery behavior are absent; blade performance and real equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.094 × 0.205 × 0.669 m; 7,052 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
